client.aka.description: Client alternate name or also-known-as name for Will opening and family declarations.

client.state.description: State code used for state-specific clauses and execution rules.

client.street_address.description: Client's street address for incapacity documents.

client.signing_county.description: County used in execution and notary blocks.

client.date_of_birth.description: Client date of birth for HIPAA authorization.

client.pronoun_subject.description: Subject pronoun for execution acknowledgments, such as she, he, or they.

client.pronoun_object.description: Object pronoun, such as her, him, or them.

client.pronoun_possessive.description: Possessive pronoun, such as her, his, or their.

client.county.description: County of residence or execution context.

spouse.exists.description: Whether the client has a spouse.

spouse.pronoun_subject.description: Spouse subject pronoun for spouse companion documents.

spouse.pronoun_object.description: Spouse object pronoun for spouse companion documents.

spouse.pronoun_possessive.description: Spouse possessive pronoun for spouse companion documents.

children[].minor.description: Whether a child is a minor.

fiduciaries.executor.co_primary.full_nam.description: Co-personal representative nominated when will.pr_structure is co_pr.

fiduciaries.executor.successor.full_name.description: First successor personal representative or executor.

fiduciaries.executor.co_successor.full_n.description: Co-first-successor personal representative; serves jointly with the first successor when present.

fiduciaries.executor.second_successor.fu.description: Second successor personal representative or executor.

fiduciaries.executor.co_second_successor.description: Co-second-successor personal representative; serves jointly with the second successor when present.

will.pr_structure.description: Personal representative appointment structure: single, spouse_first, or co_pr.

will.bond.description: Bond election for Will administration: no_bond or required.

will.supervision.description: Probate administration supervision election: unsupervised or supervised.

will.simultaneous_death.description: Common-disaster presumption for married wills: spouse_survives, testator_survives, or omit.

will.utma_age.description: Age for custodial distributions under the Massachusetts Uniform Transfers to Minors Act.

will.no_contest_clause.description: Whether to include the Will no-contest clause: omit or include.

will.include_disclaimer_article.description: Whether to include the Will disclaimer article.

will.include_self_proving_affidavit.description: Whether to include the state self-proving affidavit after the Will execution block.

will.tangible_personal_property.distribu.description: Tangible personal property distribution method, such as children_then_descendants, spouse_then_children, named_then_children, or memorandum.

will.tangible_personal_property.named_in.description: Named recipient when tangible personal property uses the named_then_children method.

will.pet_care.option.description: Pet-care selection: omit, direct_bequest, or pet_trust.

will.pet_care.cash_amount.description: Formatted cash amount for direct pet-care bequest or pet trust funding.

will.pet_care.primary_caretaker.full_nam.description: Primary caretaker for direct pet-care bequest.

will.pet_care.successor_caretaker.full_n.description: Successor caretaker for direct pet-care bequest.

will.pet_care.pet_trustee.full_name.description: Pet trustee when the pet-trust option is selected.

will.pet_care.remainder_beneficiary.full.description: Remainder beneficiary for unused pet-trust funds.

will.pet_care.enforcer.full_name.description: Pet-trust enforcer required for statutory pet trusts.

fiduciaries.agent.primary.full_name.description: Primary agent under durable power of attorney.

fiduciaries.agent.co_primary.full_name.description: Co-agent under durable power of attorney.

fiduciaries.agent.co_agents_action.description: How co-agents act under the durable power of attorney: separate, joint, or majority.

dpoa.include_section_l.description: Whether to include the spousal proximity and support provision.

dpoa.self_dealing_reviewer.full_name.description: Reviewer whose written assent may be relied upon for self-dealing actions under the durable power of attorney.

dpoa.self_dealing_reviewer_alt.full_name.description: Alternate reviewer for self-dealing actions if the primary reviewer is unavailable.

outright_will.residuary.disposition.description: Standalone outright will residuary disposition: spouse_then_descendants, descendants_then_heirs, or named.

outright_will.residuary.named.full_name.description: Named residuary beneficiary when the standalone outright will disposition is named.

outright_will.residuary.alternate.full_n.description: Alternate residuary beneficiary when the standalone outright will disposition is named.

testamentary_trust.trustee_structure.description: Testamentary trustee nomination structure: single, spouse_first, co_trustees, or unset.

testamentary_trust.beneficiary_structure.description: Testamentary trust beneficiary structure, such as descendants_per_stirpes, spouse_hems_then_descendants, or single_beneficiary.

testamentary_trust.age_distribution_sche.description: Age distribution schedule for descendants or spouse-then-descendants testamentary trust shares.

testamentary_trust.single_beneficiary.fu.description: Named beneficiary when the testamentary trust beneficiary structure is single_beneficiary.

testamentary_trust.remainder_beneficiary.description: Remainder beneficiary when the testamentary trust beneficiary structure is single_beneficiary.

testamentary_trust.trust_protector_reque.description: Whether the Testamentary Trust Will includes a trust protector provision.

testamentary_trust.trust_protector.full_.description: Trust protector name when a trust protector provision is requested.

fiduciaries.testamentary_trustee.primary.description: Primary trustee nominated for any testamentary trust created under the Will.

fiduciaries.testamentary_trustee.co_prim.description: Co-trustee nominated when the testamentary trustee structure is co_trustees.

fiduciaries.testamentary_trustee.success.description: Successor trustee nominated for any testamentary trust created under the Will.

fiduciaries.testamentary_trustee.co_trus.description: How testamentary co-trustees act when serving together: majority or unanimous.

guardians.primary.full_name.description: Primary guardian nominee when minor children exist.

guardians.excluded[].full_name.description: Individuals excluded from serving as guardian when minor children exist.

healthcare.agent.primary.relationship.description: Relationship of primary health care agent.

healthcare.agent.primary.address.description: Address of primary health care agent.

healthcare.agent.primary.phone.description: Phone number of primary health care agent.

healthcare.anatomical_gift.description: Health Care Proxy anatomical gift election: all, specified, none, or unset.

healthcare.anatomical_specified.description: Specified organs, tissues, parts, or purposes when the anatomical gift election is specified.

hipaa.psychotherapy_notes.description: HIPAA psychotherapy notes disclosure election: authorize, do_not_authorize, or unset.

execution.doc_date.description: Document date for execution blocks when signing is scheduled; otherwise a blank date line is rendered.

execution.signing_scheduled.description: Whether a signing date, signing county, and notary commission expiration are known.

execution.signing_county.description: Signing county when signing is scheduled; falls back to client.signing_county when present.

execution.ordinal_doc_date.description: Ordinal execution date phrase, such as the 21st day of May, 2026.

execution.display_doc_date.description: Rendered execution date for signing blocks; uses execution.signing_month and execution.signing_year when known, otherwise a blank date line.

execution.display_ordinal_doc_date.description: Rendered ordinal execution date phrase for will execution clauses; uses execution.signing_month and execution.signing_year when known, otherwise a blank ordinal date line.

execution.display_signing_county.description: Rendered signing county for notary blocks; uses execution.signing_county when known, otherwise a blank county line.

execution.display_notary_commission.description: Rendered notary commission expiration for notary blocks; uses notary_commission_expiration when known, otherwise a blank commission line.

specific_gifts[].description: Specific gifts of property or cash.

charitable_gifts[].description: Charitable gifts included in the plan.

trust.date.description: Date of the trust agreement, formatted as Month Day, Year when known.

trust.display_date.description: Generated display value for the trust date; renders a blank date line when trust.date is unknown.

trust.disinherited[].description: Persons specifically disinherited by the trust.

trust.blended_family.client_children[].description: Children of the client grantor treated as children of both grantors in a joint trust.

trust.blended_family.spouse_children[].description: Children of the spouse grantor treated as children of both grantors in a joint trust.

trust.contingent_beneficiary.full_name.description: Contingent beneficiary for the residuary trust fund if no descendant survives.

trust.tangible_personal_property.distrib.description: Tangible personal property method, such as equal_shares or priority_order.

trust.tangible_personal_property.benefic.description: Named beneficiaries for equal-share tangible personal property distribution.

trust.tangible_personal_property.priorit.description: Priority-order beneficiaries for tangible personal property distribution.

trust.descendants_distribution.method.description: Descendant distribution method, such as outright or staged.

trust.descendants_distribution.distribut.description: Age for outright descendant distribution if retained in trust until a stated age.

fiduciaries.trustee.successor.full_name.description: Second successor trustee for the individual single revocable trust.

fiduciaries.trustee.second_successor.ful.description: Third successor trustee for the individual single revocable trust.

fiduciaries.trustee.co_trustees_action.description: Whether co-trustees at the same level act jointly or independently.

execution.id_type.description: Identification evidence used in the notarial acknowledgment.
